statement: One globally shared path edge basis gives K<=13, w_Z<=10, total incidence<=16 and D<=196, without added data qubits or source energy/temperature penalty. A block Clifford on at most three edge qubits conjugates every individual source term/coefficient, all syndrome projectors and the full Gibbs law exactly at every beta. This is source-H conjugacy, not whole-spectrum equality of different native compilations: two-body native interactions must be compiled again. Against the strongest unchanged K15 baseline, the peak coefficient certificate ratio is (13/15)^3, about .650963. A new data fault maps to at most three old qubits and a native prefix to at most 39; general dressed support is at most 3d+39c. The analogous dictionary replaces 15 by 13 with the same edge-block contacts. Noise spreading and optimized physical tolerances remain charged, so K13 is not automatically preferable. The declared atlas supplies recursive exact rotated-port identity; figure captions alone do not certify unspecified other cellulations.
